AfrrActivatedAutomatic.title: aFRR, Activated Automatic Frequency Restoration Reserves (Discontinued, please read description)
AfrrActivatedAutomatic.description:
This dataset is no longer updated after October 2nd, 2024, because of the go-live of the PICASSO platform.

Activated aFRR, also called secondary reserve, is used to restore frequency to the normal band (49.9-50.1 Hz) after the primary regulation (FCR) has stabilised the frequency.

The dataset has been decommissioned on the 1st of September 2025.

Gas Capacity Usage shows the capacity, available and booked capacity at each entry/exit point in the Danish gas market.

The view is updated frequently during the gas day.

GasComposition.description: The dataset contains the hourly non-validated gas composition and other gas quality parameters for the Danish Transmission as measured at Energinet’s gas quality measuring station in Egtved.

GasCompositionMonthly.title: Gas Composition and Quality for Transmission, Monthly
GasCompositionMonthly.caution: Due to the decommissioning of the model used for the Methane Number, no additional values will be uploaded after October 1st, 2024. However, the historical data will be preserved.
GasCompositionMonthly.description: Gas quality data for the Danish transmission grid that is representative for gas delivered from the transmission grid. The data are validated but the data cannot be used for billing purposes. The basis of the dataset is hourly values and the maximal and minimal value is therefore respective the maximal and minimal hourly value.

GasCompositionYearly.title: Gas Composition and Quality for Transmission, Yearly
GasCompositionYearly.caution: Due to the decommissioning of the model used for the Methane Number, no additional values will be uploaded after October 1st, 2024. However, the historical data will be preserved.

GasDailyBalancingPrice.title: Gas Daily Balancing Price
GasDailyBalancingPrice.caution:
The dataset seems to have missing values, but a closer look reveals that it currently is including meaningless, future prices. 
We are investigating root cause...
GasDailyBalancingPrice.description:
This views shows the prices used for the invoicing of the daily sale og purchase of balance gas after 01-10-2022.

Prices will remain unvalidated until the invoicing of balancing gas. Non-valid balancing gas prices should provide Shippers with an indication on what to expect.

Gasflow.title: Commercial Gas Amounts
Gasflow.description: Daily commercial gas amounts in the Danish gas market. The data is accumulated from the previous gas day.

GasMonthlyNeutralPrice.title: Gas Monthly Neutral Price DKK/kWh
GasMonthlyNeutralPrice.description: The monthly neutral gas price is used for saldo invoicing.

GasSystemBalanceUntil20221001.title: Gas Daily System Commercial Balance before 01-10-2022 (Discontinued, please read description)
GasSystemBalanceUntil20221001.description:
This dataset contains data until 01-10-2022. For data after September 2022, find data here: [Gas Daily System Commercial Balance](https://www.energidataservice.dk/tso-gas/GasSystemCommercialBalance).

The Gas Daily System Commercial Balance shows the gas balance in the Danish transmission system after each gas day according to the balance rules before the 1st of October 2022.

GasSystemCommercialBalance.title: Gas Daily System Commercial Balance
GasSystemCommercialBalance.description: The Gas Daily System Commercial Balance shows the gas balance in the Danish transmission system after each gas day.

GenerationProdTypeExchange.title: Generation per Production Type and Exchange
GenerationProdTypeExchange.caution:

The URL/endpoint will remain unchanged. However, the values will be calculated using a different method.  **Expected implementation date: October / November.**
GenerationProdTypeExchange.description:
Production per fuel, exchange and total consumption per bidding zone.

The dataset combines fast updated data with more correct settlement data. Only the best data is shown per time period. No filters are needed.

GridCapacityMapDSO.description:

The dataset is the quarterly dataset that describes the grid capacity at the DSO level, capacity at the general level, and for wind and solar production units.

GridCapacityMapDSOProductionandConsumpti.description:

HerfindahlHirschmanIndexHHIPerGridarea.title: Herfindahl - Hirschman Index (HHI) per Grid Area (will be Discontinued, please read description)
HerfindahlHirschmanIndexHHIPerGridarea.caution:
The dataset will be discontinued on 26 October 2026. Historical data will still be available.\
The index is no longer being calculated, as it has consistently remained below 1.500 on a national level since January 2023. A value below 1.500 is widely recognized as indicating a healthy level of competition.
HerfindahlHirschmanIndexHHIPerGridarea.description:
Herfindahl - Hirschman Index (HHI) is a method used to determine the market competitiveness.

Data is updated on the 8th the following month.

ImbalancePrice.title: Imbalance Price
ImbalancePrice.description: This dataset shows all relevant information regarding the imbalance price design. The data is in 15-minute resolution and shows satisfied demand and the imbalance price and contains all the components relevant to the imbalance price, including the aFRR volumes, aFRR volume-weighted average price, and the mFRR marginal price.

InertiaNordicSyncharea.title: Inertia, Nordic Synchronous Area
InertiaNordicSyncharea.description: The inertia reflects the rotating mass of the active production units. The unit is GWs.

mFRRCapacityMarket.title: mFRR, manual Frequency Restoration Reserves, Capacity Market
mFRRCapacityMarket.description: Energinet makes daily procurement of manuel frequency restoration reserves (mFRR), on an hourly capacity market. This site provides market-related information for the balancing capacity market, which runs every morning. Here, you can find details on requested demand, procured volumes, and reserve prices across different directions and price areas per hour.

MfrrCapacityMarketExtra.title: mFRR, manual Frequency Restoration Reserves, Capacity Market, Extra Auctions
MfrrCapacityMarketExtra.description: Energinet makes procurement of manuel frequency restoration reserves (mFRR) in an afternoon auction on an hourly capacity market – only if additional reserves are needed. This site provides market-related information for the balancing capacity market. Here, you can find details on requested demand, procured volumes, and reserve prices across different directions and price areas per hour.

MfrrEnergyActivationMarket.title: mFRR Energy Activation Market
MfrrEnergyActivationMarket.caution: During the period 00:15–08:15 (Time DK) on 26 April 2026, incorrect values occur in 4 columns. Values in the “mFRR SA req (up/down)” columns should have been 0. Values in the “Total mFRR (up/down)” columns are also incorrect. The affected values cannot be corrected.
MfrrEnergyActivationMarket.description:
The dataset consolidates prices and volumes from the mFRR Energy Activation Market and provides a comprehensive overview of the different activation types within the market.
The mFRR Energy Activation Market (EAM) dataset is dynamic; therefore, some data may be updated prior to and/or during the MTU as scheduled activations and direct activations occur.
The data provide an indication of the expected dominating direction for the MTU. However, the final calculation of satisfied demand determines t

Amount and prices of manual Frequency Restoration Reserves (mFRR), also called manual reserves, in bidding zone (Price area) DK1.

Amount and prices of manual Frequency Restoration Reserves (mFRR), also called manual reserves, in bidding zone (Price area) DK2.

MrStationsGasquality.caution: Minor rounding errors have occured in the columns *’Gross Calorific Value (MJ/Nm3)’, ’Gross Calorific Value (kWh/Nm3)’, ‘Wobbe index (MJ/Nm3)’, ‘Wobbe index (kWh/Nm3)’, ‘Flow’ and ’Normal Density (kg/Nm3)’*. Data have been corrected backwards and is now correct from 2022-01-01.
MrStationsGasquality.description: The dataset consists of the gas quality values: Gross Calorific Values, Wobbe Index, and Normal Density for the delivered natural gas from the transmission grid to each meter and regulator stations in Denmark.

In NordPool Spot market players can buy and sell electricity for delivery the following day in their own area - Norway, Sweden, Finland, Denmark or Germany.

PowerSupplierChangePerGridarea.title: Change of Electricity Suppliers per Grid Area
PowerSupplierChangePerGridarea.description: Number of changes in electricity suppliers per grid area.

PowerSystemRightNow.description: Production, flow, and balance on interconnectors right now in one-minute resolution.

* Withdrawal capacity

* Injection on firm terms
* Injection on interruptible terms
* Withdrawal on firm firms
* Withdrawal on interruptible terms

StorageUtilization.title: Storage Utilization
StorageUtilization.description: The expected and actual availability of injection and withdrawal capacity shown as percentage of the total technical capacity.
